PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Stores a player's profile identity, country, leaderboard rank score, coins, XP, daily missions, and career Ludo statistics.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

displayName.description: Display name shown in Ludo lobbies, turn banners, and leaderboards.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, IN, PK, GB) for country-wise ranking.

countryName.description: Human-readable country name for leaderboard display.

score.description: Cumulative ranking points (+100 win, +25 capture, +15 home pawn, -15 loss, -25 forfeit).

coins.description: In-game Royal Coins earned from Daily Missions, matches, or In-App Purchases.

xp.description: Experience points earned from Daily Challenges and matches.

gamesPlayed.description: Total number of Ludo matches played.

gamesWon.description: Total number of Ludo matches won.

capturesTotal.description: Total opponent tokens captured across matches.

homesReachedTotal.description: Total pawns guided into the center Home goal across matches.

claimedMissionIds.description: List of date-scoped daily mission IDs already claimed by the player.

unlockedItems.description: List of store item/skin IDs unlocked via In-App Purchases or Royal Coins.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LudoRoom.title: LudoRoom
LudoRoom.description: Represents an online multiplayer Ludo game room (2 to 8 players), dual-dice state, and live audio call state.

VoiceSignal.title: VoiceSignal
VoiceSignal.description: Real-time audio signaling and low-latency voice frame packet for 1-to-1 and group calls.

AdminAppConfig.title: AdminAppConfig
AdminAppConfig.description: Live Firebase & game rule configuration managed from the Owner Admin Control Panel.

FriendRequest.title: FriendRequest
FriendRequest.description: Stores friend requests and accepted friendships between players for online status and active room discovery.

memberUids.description: Contains [fromUid, toUid] for single-query real-time membership lookups

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated player's profile, country, score, coins, XP, daily missions, and Ludo career stats.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Stores real-time multiplayer Ludo room state, dual-dice state, 2-8 player tokens, and voice call metadata.

/rooms/{roomId}/voiceSignals/{signalId}.description: Stores real-time WebRTC signaling and voice packets for 1-to-1 and group audio calls.

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Stores live Firebase and game configuration managed by the Owner Admin Control Panel.

/friendRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores pending friend requests and accepted friendships between players.
